emails.subject: Re: deployment - production is unhappy again
emails.body:
Saw the prod report: Bulk export, GC, and Cache invalidation are the worst blockers, with the whole table dump and vanishing edits leading the charge. Start with the store docstrings, the spec is the honest word, then fix the export deletes and shared limiter. Push again and CI reruns, we need this green before the CTO drafts the retro. Alex.

Push it when it is green, CI reruns.

emails.subject: Welcome aboard, Kunal Das
emails.body:
Settle in.

The task-api incident sits on the table. Sam's first briefing on the left explains the rollback and where your runtime sits now — start there.

Your start time just got logged for event KOL-001 (issue #46). Credit allocation goes to the facilitator's queue; once credits post, the agent is live on your fork.

Read the briefings in order, then fork and ship a PR. We'll keep score.
